name: DeepSeek-V2
notes: The model that introduced MLA as the reason it is in this repo. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 60 layers x (512 + 64) x 2 = 69,120 B/token (67.5 KiB), same latent formula as V3 and still 58x smaller than the naive GQA figure (60 x 128 x 128 x 2 x 2 = 3,932,160 B). Smaller than V3 in every axis: hidden 5120, 60 layers, 160 routed + 2 shared experts, 6 per token, intermediate 12288, moe_intermediate 1536, first_k_dense_replace 1. Vendor figures 236B total / 21B activated; our arithmetic gives 235.7B / 21.3B. Interesting serving artifact: rope_scaling mscale is 0.707 here vs 1.0 in V3, so V2 needed an attention temperature correction that V3 dropped. YaRN factor 40 over 4096.
